fields.Intake — Published:
240 PGDM seats, AICTE EOA 2025–26 (increased from 180 in 2024–25); current 2026–27 approval not recovered.
Published numeric intake: 240
fields.Fees — Published:
Official 2025–26 PGDM Core with two majors: ₹8 lakh; Analytics: ₹8.50 lakh. Includes laptop, examination, enrolment and foreign trip; uniform and living extra. Current 2026–28 revision unconfirmed.
Numeric fee reference ₹L: 8
fields.Fee Scope: Reference: PGDM Core, 2025–26. Analytics is separately priced at ₹8.50 lakh. Uniform and living costs excluded.
fields.Accepted Exams: LAT or recognised national management tests including CAT, MAT and XAT.
fields.Eligibility: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from recognised university: 50% General/OBC, 45% SC/ST; final-year students can apply.
fields.Selection Process: Lloyd Admission Test or accepted national test, group discussion and personal interview.
fields.Avg CTC — Published:
₹7.22 lakh for PGDM 2023–25, according to secondary cohort reporting; official admissions page corroborates the ₹7.22 lakh headline.
Reported mean ₹L: 7.22

₹24.80 L domestic; ₹25 L international(2025 placement summary)
Reported highest ₹L: 24.8
fields.Placement Scope: PGDM 2023–25 per secondary 2025 report; official career page confirms mean ₹7.22 lakh and highest ₹24.8 lakh, without a cohort date.
fields.Top Recruiters: Accenture; ITC; BigBasket; DHL; ICICI Bank; HDFC L ife; Godrej; Decathlon (reportedPGDM recruiters)
